# simplevm_snapshot (Resource)

A snapshot image of a SimpleVM VM.

Creating a snapshot is asynchronous: the provider polls the project's snapshot images until the new image is `active`; see `timeouts`. A snapshot that enters an error status fails the apply. A snapshot that is not `active` when the create timeout runs out only causes a warning: it is kept in state with its last observed `status` (`pending` while SimpleVM does not list it yet), may still complete, and is not created again by the next apply.

**The SimpleVM API cannot delete snapshots.** Destroying this resource only removes the snapshot from state and emits a warning; delete the image in the SimpleVM portal under Images/Snapshots. If an image that was listed before disappears outside Terraform, the resource is removed from state on the next refresh; an image that was never listed is kept.

Every argument replaces the snapshot when changed. **Import is not supported.**

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "simplevm_vm" "web" {
  name   = "web"
  flavor = "de.NBI default"
  image  = "Ubuntu-22.04"
}

# Snapshots cannot be deleted through the SimpleVM API: destroying this
# resource only removes it from state.
resource "simplevm_snapshot" "before_upgrade" {
  vm_id       = simplevm_vm.web.id
  name        = "web-before-upgrade"
  description = "State of the web VM before the upgrade"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description of the snapshot. Changing it creates a new snapshot.
- `name` (String) Name of the snapshot image. Changing it creates a new snapshot.
- `vm_id` (String) UUID of the VM to snapshot. Changing it creates a new snapshot.

### Optional

- `project_id` (Number) ID of the SimpleVM project of the snapshot. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`, then to the project of the VM. Changing it creates a new snapshot.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) Timeouts for long-running operations, as Go durations such as `30m` or `1h`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the snapshot as reported by SimpleVM.
- `id` (String) OpenStack ID of the snapshot image.
- `status` (String) Status of the snapshot image as reported by SimpleVM, for example `active`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Timeout for the create operation (default `1h0m`). A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
